title: Hourly Auto-Dig:IISS Arundel House headquarters and current-news scan
summary: Dataset-first dark-academia pass resolves IISS headquarters at Arundel House from current first-party evidence, preserves other international offices separately, and records a bounded no-filler current-news result.

sources.title: Sir John Chipman:A Strategic Lifetime – Introduction

data.research_question: What defensible public headquarters geography can be added for the globally selected IISS target, and what material current news updates the existing dataset after the location slice?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent merged hourly runs, open PRs/issues, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema surfaces and the current 54-entry dataset/topic universe through the GitHub connector. Applied two-stage dataset-first sampling independent of row count. Hard-excluded the previous three successful hourly datasets and avoided their dominant geographies where alternatives existed. The dataset-stage seed selected the dark-academia composite. Within its 19-source canonical organization pool, deterministic target draws rejected only completed/recent location work, direct active PR overlaps or repeated Washington/New York geography; the first acceptable target was iiss-public-roster / starintel:org:international-institute-for-strategic-studies. First-party IISS material explicitly identifies Arundel House as the London headquarters and the contact page supplies the exact address while listing Washington, Singapore, Bahrain and Berlin separately as offices. No coordinates were inferred. Only after fixing headquarters semantics, current IISS press, careers, publication, appointment, partnership and location searches through 2026-08-19 were reviewed. The newest material was routine publications, event promotion and vacancies; no material organizational, governance, relationship or location change warranted a filler event.
classification_rules: Dataset-stage probability is independent of record count.
The previous three successful hourly datasets are hard exclusions when alternatives exist.
Previous-three dominant geographies are avoided when alternatives exist.
Direct active file/record overlap is rejected when a non-conflicting alternative exists.
Headquarters, office, registered office, legal seat and facility remain separate predicates.
No coordinates are created without defensible geocoder or first-party coordinate evidence.
Current news is ingested only when it materially changes an event, claim, relation, location or organizational state.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort the complete dataset/topic pool; hard-exclude the previous three successful hourly datasets; choose the dataset with run_seed modulo eligible dataset count; for a composite dataset, draw deterministically from the sorted canonical organization/source-dataset target pool with SHA-256 retry draws, rejecting only documented completed work, direct active overlaps, or previous-three geography repeats

findings.target_count_note: 37 normalized investigation-target records were observed in the current-main frontier audit; the selected dark-academia composite contains 19 canonical source-roster organization targets.

findings.finding: Current first-party IISS material explicitly identifies Arundel House as the London headquarters. The official contact page resolves the address as Arundel House, 6 Temple Place, London WC2R 2PG and lists Washington, Singapore, Bahrain and Berlin separately as offices.

Post-location searches through 2026-08-19 found current vacancies, routine publications and event promotion but no material organizational, governance, relationship or location change requiring ingestion. The IISS press-release index's newest listed organizational/partnership release was 2026-06-29, so no filler event was created.

caveats: No coordinates were collected or inferred.
The pass does not equate operational headquarters with a statutory or registered office; that remains a recursive target.
